name: tailscale
summary: Tailscale API v2: read devices, the access policy and auth-key expiry dates (reads); every change asks first
notes: The secret is a Tailscale API access token (or an OAuth client's token); an access token expires after the 1 to 90 days chosen when it was made, so this connection stops working on that date.
Reads: GET /tailnet/-/devices, GET /tailnet/-/acl, GET /tailnet/-/keys (the key list carries each key's expiry). '-' means the tailnet of the token.
Every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE asks first: the API can change the access policy and delete devices.
